Services

Acme offers four service lines across the Lahore district.

Emergency callouts

Acme dispatches a plumber within 90 minutes, 24 hours a day. Emergency cover runs every day of the year including public holidays.

Response times

A callout inside Lahore is answered within 90 minutes. A callout in Kasur is answered within 3 hours. Response times are measured from the confirmed booking.

Bathroom installation

A full bathroom installation takes four to six working days. Acme sources fittings from three certified suppliers.
